card.title: Exactly the Victory I Meant
card.instruction: Celebrate every reversal as though it secretly delivers the outcome you wanted, while preserving enthusiasm for all earlier outcomes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've been chosen to run the chess club tournament! Finally, I can shape the whole day.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They changed their minds. You're on refreshments.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful! Running it was a triumph; now I get the personal contact I wanted too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a self-service urn. I only need you to refill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect! Leadership, hospitality, and now uninterrupted time to study chess. Every appointment has been inspired.
